entities.summary: Peter Agostini (1913-1993) was a major American sculptor, credited as a Pop Art pioneer of the 1960s, along with Andy Warhol and Claes Oldenburg. He also "never abandoned the traditional subjects of sculpture like the human head and figure, and particularly the horse.". Peter Agostini was a painters & sculptors from Hell's Kitchen (1913-02-13, Hell's Kitchen–1993-03-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
